items.title: Creating websites in minutes with AI Website Builder
items.summary: Wix’s AI Website Builder, powered by OpenAI, lets anyone create a full website in minutes—just by describing their idea in a conversation.
items.summaryZh: Wix推出了基于OpenAI大模型的AI网站构建器，允许用户通过自然语言对话在数分钟内自动生成功能齐备的完整网站，推动了LLM在无代码建站领域的应用落地。原始信息显示：Wix’s AI Website Builder, powered by OpenAI, lets anyone create a full website in minutes—just by describing their idea in a conversation.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Creating websites in minutes with AI Website Builder”。其重要性主要体现在：展示了OpenAI大模型在网站构建垂直领域的真实商业落地案例。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
